---
title: "Prasanga Paudel | Data Analysis Portfolio"
---

<style>
.quarto-title-block { display: none; }

.portfolio-page {
  margin: -2rem -1rem -3rem;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: #0b0d10;
  color: #f4f6f8;
}

.portfolio-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

.portfolio-hero,
.portfolio-section,
.portfolio-footer {
  max-width: 1250px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-left: 2rem;
  padding-right: 2rem;
}

.portfolio-hero {
  padding-top: 7rem;
  padding-bottom: 6rem;
}

.hero-label,
.section-label {
  color: #9aa4ae;
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.portfolio-hero h1 {
  margin: 1rem 0 0;
  color: #f4f6f8 !important;
  font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 9vw, 8rem);
  line-height: .9;
  letter-spacing: -.06em;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.hero-description {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 2rem 0 0;
  color: #9aa4ae;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .75rem;
  margin-top: 2rem;
}

.hero-action {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: .8rem 1.2rem;
  border: 1px solid #303740;
  color: #f4f6f8 !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  font-size: .82rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
  transition: .2s ease;
}

.hero-action:hover {
  background: #f4f6f8;
  color: #0b0d10 !important;
}

.portfolio-section {
  padding-top: 4rem;
  padding-bottom: 4rem;
}

.section-title {
  margin: .55rem 0 2rem;
  color: #f4f6f8 !important;
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: -.03em;
}

.language-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  border-top: 1px solid #303740;
  border-left: 1px solid #303740;
}

.language-card {
  min-height: 290px;
  padding: 1.75rem;
  background: #11151a;
  border-right: 1px solid #303740;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #303740;
  color: #f4f6f8 !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition: .22s ease;
}

.language-card:hover {
  background: #191f26;
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

.card-number {
  color: #68727d;
  font-size: .7rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
}

.language-name {
  margin-top: 3rem;
  color: #f4f6f8 !important;
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 850;
}

.language-description {
  margin: .6rem 0 0;
  max-width: 230px;
  color: #89939e;
  font-size: .88rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.card-arrow {
  align-self: flex-end;
  color: #cbd2d9;
  font-size: 1.4rem;
}

.project-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  border-top: 1px solid #303740;
  border-left: 1px solid #303740;
}

.project-card {
  min-height: 220px;
  padding: 2rem;
  background: #11151a;
  border-right: 1px solid #303740;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #303740;
  color: #f4f6f8 !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: .22s ease;
}

.project-card:hover { background: #191f26; }

.project-tag {
  color: #68727d;
  font-size: .7rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .14em;
}

.project-card h3 {
  margin: 1.5rem 0 .6rem;
  color: #f4f6f8 !important;
  font-size: 1.55rem;
}

.project-card p {
  max-width: 500px;
  margin: 0;
  color: #89939e;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.portfolio-footer {
  padding-top: 2rem;
  padding-bottom: 4rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #303740;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2rem;
}

.portfolio-footer h2 {
  margin: 0 0 .4rem;
  color: #f4f6f8 !important;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
}

.portfolio-footer p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #89939e;
}

.footer-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.footer-links a {
  color: #f4f6f8 !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #303740;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .language-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .portfolio-hero { padding-top: 5rem; }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .portfolio-hero,
  .portfolio-section,
  .portfolio-footer {
    padding-left: 1.25rem;
    padding-right: 1.25rem;
  }

  .portfolio-hero { padding-top: 4rem; }
  .portfolio-hero h1 { font-size: 3.6rem; }
  .language-grid,
  .project-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .portfolio-footer { display: block; }
  .footer-links { margin-top: 1.5rem; }
}
</style>
